# entr - Event Notify Test Runner

A utility for running arbitrary commands when files change. `entr` watches files and executes commands when they are modified.

## Description

`entr` reads a list of files from standard input and executes a specified command when any of those files change. It provides a fast, efficient way to get rapid feedback during development.

## Usage

```
entr [-acdnprsxz] utility [argument /_ ...]
```

## Options

- `-a` - Respond to all events which occur while the utility is running
- `-c` - Clear the screen before invoking the utility (specify twice to erase scrollback)
- `-d` - Track the parent directory of files. Specify twice to recognize all new directory entries
- `-n` - Run in non-interactive mode
- `-p` - Postpone the first execution until a file is modified
- `-r` - Reload a persistent child process
- `-s` - Evaluate the first argument using the SHELL environment variable
- `-x` - Format custom exit status messages using awk
- `-z` - Exit after the utility completes

## Special Features

- The argument `/_` is replaced with the absolute path of the first file to trigger an event
- Press `space` to manually execute the utility
- Press `q` to quit

## Environment Variables

- `ENTR_STATUS_SCRIPT` - Path to exit status script (default: `$HOME/.entr/status.awk`)
- `ENTR_RESTART_SIGNAL` - Signal used to terminate the utility (HUP, INT, QUIT, TERM, USR1, USR2)
- `ENTR_INOTIFY_WORKAROUND` - Enable for incomplete inotify support (WSL, Docker for Mac)
- `ENTR_FOLLOW_SYMLINK` - Follow symlinks (Mac OS and Linux)
- `EV_TRACE` - Print file system event messages
- `SHELL` - Specify shell for `-s` flag (default: `/bin/sh`)
- `PAGER` - Default set to `/bin/cat`

## Examples

Rebuild a project if source files change, limiting output to the first 20 lines:

```bash
$ find src/ | entr -s 'make | head -n 20'
```

Launch and auto-reload a node.js server:

```bash
$ ls *.js | entr -r node app.js
```

Clear the screen and run a query after the SQL script is updated:

```bash
$ echo my.sql | entr -cp psql -f /_
```

Rebuild project if a source file is modified or added to the src/ directory:

```bash
$ while sleep 0.1; do ls -d src src/*.rb | entr -d make; done
```

Auto-reload a web server, or terminate if the server exits:

```bash
$ ls * | entr -rz ./httpd
```

## Exit Status

When `-z` flag is set, returns the exit status of the child process.

Otherwise:
- `0` - Normal termination after receiving SIGINT
- `1` - No regular files provided or error occurred
- `2` - Files were added or removed from a directory

## Interactive Commands

While entr is running:
- `space` - Execute the utility immediately
- `q` - Quit

## Platform Support

Supported on BSD, Mac OS, and Linux systems. On Mac OS and Linux, symlinks are not followed unless `ENTR_FOLLOW_SYMLINK` is set.

For environments with incomplete inotify support (Windows Subsystem for Linux, Docker for Mac), set `ENTR_INOTIFY_WORKAROUND` to enable proper operation.

Respond to all events which occur while the

is running.
Without this option,

.It Fl c

.Ar utility
specified on the command line.
Specify twice to erase the scrollback buffer.
.It Fl d
Track the parent directory of regular files provided as input.
If specified twice, all new entries to a directory are recognized, otherwise
files with names beginning with
.Ql \&.
are ignored.
.It Fl n
Run in non-interactive mode.
In this mode
.Nm entr
does not attempt to read from the TTY or change its properties.
.It Fl p
Postpone the first execution of the
.Ar utility
until a file is modified.
.It Fl r
Reload a persistent child process.
As with the standard mode of operation, a
.Ar utility
which terminates is not executed again until a file system or keyboard event is
processed.
A process group is created to prevent shell scripts from masking signals.
.Nm
waits for the
.Ar utility
to exit to ensure that resources such as sockets have been closed.
Control of the TTY is not transferred to the child process.

import subprocess, time, os, sys, signal, threading
def ex(args, files, ops, env=None, cwd='/tmp/t1', total=5, setup=True):
    env = env or dict(os.environ)
    if setup: subprocess.run('rm -rf /tmp/t1; mkdir -p /tmp/t1/d1; echo hello > /tmp/t1/a.txt; echo b > /tmp/t1/b.txt; touch /tmp/t1/d1/f1', shell=True)
    p = subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, cwd=cwd, env=env, start_new_session=True)
    p.stdin.write(files.encode()); p.stdin.close()
    t0=time.time()
    lines=[]
    def rd():
        for l in iter(p.stdout.readline, b''):
            lines.append((time.time()-t0, 'O', l))
    th=threading.Thread(target=rd); th.start()
    def waiter():
        p.wait(); lines.append((time.time()-t0,'X','exit rc=%d'%p.returncode))
    tw=threading.Thread(target=waiter); tw.start()
    for op in ops:
        if isinstance(op,(int,float)): time.sleep(op); continue
        lines.append((time.time()-t0, 'M', op if isinstance(op,str) else str(op)))
        if isinstance(op,str): subprocess.run(op, shell=True, cwd=cwd)
        elif isinstance(op,tuple): os.kill(p.pid, op[1]) if op[0]=='sig' else os.killpg(p.pid, op[1])
        else: op(p)
    tw.join(total)
    if tw.is_alive():
        os.killpg(p.pid,9); lines.append((time.time()-t0,'K','KILLED'))
        tw.join()
    th.join(1)
    lines.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    for t,k,x in lines: print("%.4f %s %r"%(t,k,x))

import os, pty, time, sys, select, signal, subprocess, fcntl, termios, threading
ORIG='/workspace/executable'
MINE='/tmp/mine/executable'
SETUP='rm -rf /tmp/tt; mkdir -p /tmp/tt/d1; echo hello > /tmp/tt/a.txt; echo b > /tmp/tt/b.txt; touch /tmp/tt/d1/f1'
def ptyone(binary, args, files, ops, cwd='/tmp/tt', env=None, total=5):
    subprocess.run(SETUP, shell=True)
    e = dict(os.environ)
    if env: e.update(env)
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    r, w = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.setsid()
        fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        os.dup2(r, 0); os.dup2(slave, 1); os.dup2(slave, 2)
        os.close(r); os.close(w); os.close(master); os.close(slave)
        os.chdir(cwd)
        for s in (signal.SIGPIPE, signal.SIGXFSZ): signal.signal(s, signal.SIG_DFL)
        os.execve(binary, [binary]+args, e)
    os.close(r)
    os.write(w, files.encode()); os.close(w)
    t0 = time.time()
    out = []
    def rd():
        while True:
            try: d = os.read(slave_keep, 4096) if False else os.read(master, 4096)
            except OSError: break
            if not d: break
            out.append((time.time()-t0, d))
    slave_keep = slave
    th = threading.Thread(target=rd); th.daemon=True; th.start()
    st=[None]
    def wt():
        _, s = os.waitpid(pid, 0); st[0]=(os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(s), time.time()-t0)
    tw = threading.Thread(target=wt); tw.daemon=True; tw.start()
    for op in ops:
        if isinstance(op, (int, float)): time.sleep(op); continue
        if isinstance(op, bytes): os.write(master, op)
        elif isinstance(op, tuple):
            try: os.kill(pid, op[1])
            except ProcessLookupError: pass
        elif callable(op): op()
        else: subprocess.run(op, shell=True, cwd=cwd)
    tw.join(total)
    killed=False
    if tw.is_alive():
        os.killpg(pid, 9); killed=True; tw.join()
    time.sleep(0.15)
    # termios after exit
    attrs = termios.tcgetattr(slave)
    os.close(master); os.close(slave)
    data = b''.join(d for t,d in out)
    return dict(rc=st[0][0], t=st[0][1], killed=killed, out=data, lines=out, lflag=attrs[3])

def pcmp(name, args, files, ops=(), env=None, total=5, verbose=False):
    a=ptyone(ORIG,args,files,ops,env=env,total=total)
    b=ptyone(MINE,args,files,ops,env=env,total=total)

def ptyone(binary, args, files, ops, cwd='/tmp/tt', env=None, total=5):

    e = dict(os.environ)

        os.close(r); os.close(w); os.close(master); os.close(slave)
        os.chdir(cwd)
        for s in (signal.SIGPIPE, signal.SIGXFSZ): signal.signal(s, signal.SIG_DFL)
        os.execve(binary, [binary]+args, e)
    os.close(r)
    os.write(w, files.encode()); os.close(w)
    t0 = time.time()
    out = []
    def rd():
        while True:
            try: d = os.read(slave_keep, 4096) if False else os.read(master, 4096)
            except OSError: break
            if not d: break
            out.append((time.time()-t0, d))
    slave_keep = slave
    th = threading.Thread(target=rd); th.daemon=True; th.start()
    st=[None]
    def wt():

    tw = threading.Thread(target=wt); tw.daemon=True; tw.start()
    for op in ops:
        if isinstance(op, (int, float)): time.sleep(op); continue
        if isinstance(op, bytes): os.write(master, op)
        elif isinstance(op, tuple):
            try: os.kill(pid, op[1])

/* child process management */

static void
block_chld(sigset_t *old)
{
	sigset_t set;

	sigemptyset(&set);
	sigaddset(&set, SIGCHLD);
	sigprocmask(SIG_BLOCK, &set, old);
}

static void
block_all(sigset_t *old)
{
	sigset_t set;

	sigfillset(&set);
	sigprocmask(SIG_BLOCK, &set, old);
}

/* called in a freshly forked child before exec */
static void
reset_child_signals(const sigset_t *mask)
{
	struct sigaction sa;

	memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
	sa.sa_handler = SIG_DFL;
	sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
	sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGHUP, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGCHLD, &sa, NULL);
	sigprocmask(SIG_SETMASK, mask, NULL);
}

static void
terminate_utility(void)
{
	sigset_t old;
	int status;
	pid_t pid;

	if (!opt_restart || child_pid <= 0)
		return;
	block_chld(&old);
	pid = child_pid;
	terminating = 1;
	(void)killpg(pid, restart_signal);
	while (waitpid(pid, &status, 0) == -1 && errno == EINTR)
		;
	child_pid = 0;
	terminating = 0;
	sigprocmask(SIG_SETMASK, &old, NULL);
}

static void
cleanup(void)
{
	tty_restore();
	terminate_utility();
}

static void
handle_exit(int sig)
{
	struct sigaction sa;
	sigset_t set;
	int status;
	pid_t pid;

	memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
	sa.sa_handler = SIG_DFL;
	sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
	sigaction(sig, &sa, NULL);

	tty_restore();
	if (opt_restart) {
		terminate_utility();
	} else if ((pid = child_pid) > 0) {
		while (waitpid(pid, &status, 0) == -1 && errno == EINTR)
			;
		child_pid = 0;
	}
	if (status_pid > 0)
		(void)kill(status_pid, SIGKILL);

	if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGHUP)
		exit(0);

	tty_saved = 0;
	sigemptyset(&set);
	sigaddset(&set, sig);
	sigprocmask(SIG_UNBLOCK, &set, NULL);
	raise(sig);
	_exit(128 + sig);
}

static void
handle_chld(int sig)
{
	int saved_errno = errno;
	int status;
	pid_t pid;

	(void)sig;
	if (status_pid > 0) {
		pid = waitpid(status_pid, &status, WNOHANG);
		if (pid == status_pid) {
			status_pid = 0;
			warnx("status process terminated");
			handle_exit(SIGINT);

	if (opt_restart && child_pid > 0 && !terminating) {
		pid = waitpid(child_pid, &status, WNOHANG);
		if (pid == child_pid && opt_oneshot)
			exit(exit_code(status));
	}
	errno = saved_errno;
}

{
	struct sigaction sa;

	memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
	sa.sa_handler = handle_exit;
	sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
	sa.sa_flags = 0;
	if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) != 0)
		err(1, "Failed to set SIGINT handler");
	if (sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) != 0)
		err(1, "Failed to set SIGTERM handler");
	if (sigaction(SIGHUP, &sa, NULL) != 0)

	memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
	sa.sa_handler = handle_chld;
	sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
	sigaddset(&sa.sa_mask, SIGINT);
	sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART | SA_NOCLDSTOP;
	if (sigaction(SIGCHLD, &sa, NULL) != 0)
